verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Drata's Public API v2, OAuth setup, an OpenAPI-style endpoint reference, and an MCP server, but nothing mentions official client SDKs or language libraries. The only GitHub repo is the device-monitoring Drata Agent, not an SDK. A raw REST API and reference docs are building blocks, not SDKs, and probes found no downloadable OpenAPI spec for generating one. The axis applies to a SaaS platform, so absence of evidence is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
